items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: You made that record with Ike Quebec. / Ike Quebec, yes, "Cup Mute Clayton".

ctx.x: You made that record with Ike Quebec.
Ike Quebec, yes, "Cup Mute Clayton". (LAUGHTER). I didn't mind playing the cup mute sometimes, but, ......
You didn't want to be typed by it.
